name: Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures
description: Seismology, seismic risk and hazard; soil dynamics and seismic inputs to structures; single degree of freedom structures (SDOF); multi degree of freedom structures (MDOF); response spectrum analysis (RSA); earthquake resistant design philosophy; elastic static analysis; inelastic static pushover analysis; modal response spectrum analysis; dynamic analysis; dynamic soil-structure interaction; performance based earthquake engineering; code provisions for seismic design of structures; retrofitting and strengthening of structures; concept of base isolation design and structural vibration control; advanced topics in earthquake engineering.
